scope: Deeper second pass over all 44 existing repository skills; preserves earlier improvements and staging

skills.name: v-auth
skills.outcome: Updated API-key guidance for publishable/secret keys and legacy JWT role verification; reports must redact credentials.

skills.name: v-backtest-audit
skills.outcome: Pruned excluded trees before descent; notebook source boundaries and parse coverage are explicit; source counts and metric units remain evidence leads.

skills.name: v-backtest-report
skills.outcome: Unified percent-return parsing between loaders and rejected missing observations rather than silently dropping rows.

skills.name: v-baselines
skills.outcome: Added explicit task and temporal-gap controls; made fold-spread comparisons descriptive; preserved fold-local preprocessing.

skills.name: v-chrome-extension
skills.outcome: Fixed noninteractive ripgrep scans reading empty stdin; scan explicit project paths and report secret locations without values.

skills.name: v-dataset
skills.outcome: Made overlap hashes schema-aware and column-order independent; replaced per-row Series construction with tuple iteration.

skills.name: v-declutter
skills.outcome: Corrected consolidated-skill routing in the Lovable removal playbook; retained scoped rollback behavior.

skills.name: v-duckdb-layer
skills.outcome: Pruned excluded trees and report unavailable schemas as unverified instead of claiming a match.

skills.name: v-frontend
skills.outcome: Retained: focused rubric, runtime-measurement boundaries, required evidence, and existing helper behavior fit the requested scope.

skills.name: v-git
skills.outcome: Retained: intended staging, human identity, verified push remote, personal main/contribution exceptions, and draft-only boundaries are already covered.

skills.name: v-git-multi
skills.outcome: Replaced line-oriented/per-file subprocess inventory with NUL-aware Git reads and JSON-quoted filenames; stream large untracked files.

skills.name: v-metric-math
skills.outcome: Generated tests now execute resolved metric functions; cache imports, support dataclass modules, preserve existing test files unless explicitly overwritten.

skills.name: v-ml
skills.outcome: Recognize backend layouts such as app/ and api/; refresh artifact-loading guidance to distinguish trustworthy formats and code-execution risks.

skills.name: v-notebook
skills.outcome: Find promoted functions inside modules, measure UTF-8 output bytes, and replace a truncating cleanup command with a tested atomic helper.

skills.name: v-notes
skills.outcome: Require ripgrep explicitly so missing tooling is not mistaken for a clean scan; preserve target paths.

skills.name: v-notes-update
skills.outcome: Removed Bash nameref dependency for native macOS Bash 3.2; consume Git status with NUL delimiters and keep rename paths.

skills.name: v-perf
skills.outcome: Use a pruned file inventory for package discovery, avoiding dependency-tree scanning and vendor false evidence.

skills.name: v-phase
skills.outcome: Gather phase evidence in a pruned walk, distinguish exact paths from basename candidates, support spaced/encoded links, and harvest equations efficiently.

skills.name: v-post-launch
skills.outcome: Handle crawler-specific rules and Allow precedence, inspect modern metadata files, and disclose static-source coverage limits.

skills.name: v-provenance
skills.outcome: Produce clean JSON, verify hashes without profiling, fail on missing/stale cards, preserve human cards, and distinguish graph endpoints from provenance references.

skills.name: v-readme
skills.outcome: Require discovery tooling, detect Next.js before generic React, and avoid treating an empty/missing scan as verified product evidence.

skills.name: v-regression-diagnostics
skills.outcome: Resolve aliased model fits and covariance options in the fit-call inventory rather than missing ordinary usage.

skills.name: v-run-ledger
skills.outcome: Validate parameters/finite metrics before mutation, resolve data relative to the target repo, and refuse incompatible ledger schemas.

skills.name: v-scaffold
skills.outcome: Complete runtime/lint/test dependencies, validate package names, protect existing files, use supported Vite 7.3, and use Supabase publishable keys in new clients.

skills.name: v-scripts
skills.outcome: Corrected escaped ripgrep expressions so polling and I/O hotspots are actually discovered.

skills.name: v-security
skills.outcome: Require discovery tooling; refresh Supabase credential handling and credentialed CORS examples with current official guidance.

skills.name: v-shots
skills.outcome: Parse static nested routes/guards/basenames with project TypeScript, keep unresolved candidates unverified, and use visible-content readiness instead of network-idle waits.

skills.name: v-supa-migrate
skills.outcome: Retained: drafting boundary, migration history checks, generated-types precedence, explicit RLS, and protected client initializer already fit the workflow.

skills.name: v-test
skills.outcome: Retained: four selectable modes, review-only boundaries, real reproductions, score/deferral rules, and coverage limits already fit the workflow.

skills.name: v-timeseries-leakage
skills.outcome: Analyze notebook cells as one pipeline with cell locations; detect keyword negative shifts and report parse failures without inventing clean coverage.

skills.name: v-triage
skills.outcome: Fail explicitly when required discovery tooling is unavailable; preserve the smallest-fix and actual-reproduction contract.

skills.name: v-ui
skills.outcome: Retained: selective routing preserves project stack, tokens, working controls, and illustration boundaries; no extra modules are loaded by default.

skills.name: boardui
skills.outcome: Retained: current bundled catalog and compatibility checks preserve the selected React/Tailwind system and custom files; verify upstream details when used.

skills.name: component-gallery
skills.outcome: Retained: original-source/API verification, compatible component selection, licensing, and bounded discovery are already explicit.

skills.name: easyui-components
skills.outcome: Retained: current-page verification and local fallback prevent invented exports or forced library adoption.

skills.name: good-css
skills.outcome: Retained: browser-support checks, design tokens, scroll semantics, focus, and reduced-motion boundaries are already explicit.

skills.name: stageshow
skills.outcome: Retained: upstream composition/rehearsal workflow and complete source kit; no concrete current failure justified editing its implementation.

skills.name: v-venv-doctor
skills.outcome: Prefer explicitly supplied project environments and disclose missing tooling; preserve project version requirements instead of prescribing the historical stack.

skills.name: v-vercel-doctor
skills.outcome: Report missing discovery tooling honestly; preserve verified remote-environment and production-build evidence boundaries.

skills.name: v-vibe
skills.outcome: Prune generated/dependency trees before package discovery; keep architecture signals as candidates, not runtime guarantees.

skills.name: v-vibe-app
skills.outcome: Check actual Git tracking for env files, redact secret previews, recognize current secret-key patterns, and use pruned migration discovery.

skills.name: v-vibe-macos
skills.outcome: Parse XML/binary entitlement plists by exact key/value; disclose malformed files and prune vendor discovery; correct async-network guidance.

skills.name: v-vibe-ml
skills.outcome: Remove frozen model-name lists and obsolete provider recipes; retain chosen provider/model and consult current schema/model documentation.

skills.name: v-vibe-web
skills.outcome: Prune package trees, handle crawler-specific robots rules, inspect modern metadata conventions, and preserve unverified deployment distinctions.

findings.trigger: Dependency/generated directories exist below the target project
findings.impact_reason: extra traversal costs and vendor false evidence
findings.confidence: Confirmed from source and/or focused fixture behavior
findings.resolution: Prune before descending and reuse relevant inventories.

findings.trigger: A shell discovery helper runs without ripgrep
findings.impact_reason: empty scans could be read as clean evidence
findings.confidence: Confirmed from source and/or focused fixture behavior
findings.resolution: Exit with an explicit missing-tool error.

findings.trigger: Chrome source discovery runs with stdin closed or piped
findings.impact_reason: source security checks silently scan no files
findings.confidence: Confirmed from source and/or focused fixture behavior
findings.resolution: Supply explicit scan paths and retain location-only secret reports.

findings.trigger: Hotspot patterns use double-escaped ripgrep expressions
findings.impact_reason: I/O and polling evidence silently disappears
findings.confidence: Confirmed from source and/or focused fixture behavior
findings.resolution: Use valid regex patterns and exercise matching fixtures.

findings.trigger: An ignored local env file is present or a source line contains a credential
findings.impact_reason: false tracked-secret claims or credential leakage into reports
findings.confidence: Confirmed from source and/or focused fixture behavior
findings.resolution: Verify Git tracking and redact report values.

findings.trigger: A JWT prefix or legacy key example is treated as the privileged role
findings.impact_reason: incorrect privilege classification and stale new-client setup
findings.confidence: Confirmed from source and/or focused fixture behavior
findings.resolution: Distinguish publishable/secret keys and inspect legacy JWT role evidence.

findings.trigger: Sandbox entitlement is false while another entitlement is true, or the plist is binary
findings.impact_reason: sandbox protection could be falsely reported enabled
findings.confidence: Confirmed from source and/or focused fixture behavior
findings.resolution: Parse actual plist key/value pairs and disclose unreadable files.

findings.trigger: robots.txt has crawler-specific groups or competing Allow rules
findings.impact_reason: root crawl access could be reported incorrectly
findings.confidence: Confirmed from source and/or focused fixture behavior
findings.resolution: Evaluate crawler groups and rule precedence; keep static limits visible.

findings.trigger: Metadata is generated through modern framework file conventions
findings.impact_reason: source inventory misses actual metadata or invents runtime verification
findings.confidence: Confirmed from source and/or focused fixture behavior
findings.resolution: Inspect supported source conventions and label unresolved runtime behavior.

findings.trigger: Model identifiers are outside frozen scanner lists or a provider recipe has changed
findings.impact_reason: models or structured-response behavior are misclassified
findings.confidence: Confirmed from source and/or focused fixture behavior
findings.resolution: Inventory actual identifiers and use current provider guidance.

findings.trigger: CSV percent returns or missing observations enter the report loader
findings.impact_reason: units or dropped rows alter reported returns and risk
findings.confidence: Confirmed from source and/or focused fixture behavior
findings.resolution: Match percent parsing across loaders and reject missing observations.

findings.trigger: Targets are integer-valued regression or forecast labels overlap the next fold
findings.impact_reason: automatic task/protocol choice can mislead evaluation
findings.confidence: Confirmed from source and/or focused fixture behavior
findings.resolution: Expose task and temporal-gap controls and disclose assumptions.

findings.trigger: Cross-validation fold spread is described as proof of noise or no signal
findings.impact_reason: overstates the statistical conclusion
findings.confidence: Confirmed from source and/or focused fixture behavior
findings.resolution: Report the observed comparison and its descriptive limits.

findings.trigger: Split files contain identical observations with reordered columns
findings.impact_reason: overlap could be missed or unrelated schemas compared
findings.confidence: Confirmed from source and/or focused fixture behavior
findings.resolution: Canonicalize schema/order and hash tuples efficiently.

findings.trigger: Parquet schema readers are unavailable
findings.impact_reason: unknown schemas were treated as matching
findings.confidence: Confirmed from source and/or focused fixture behavior
findings.resolution: Report unavailable schema coverage as unverified.

findings.trigger: Metric benchmark emission is requested or target modules contain dataclasses
findings.impact_reason: emitted tests could all skip or target imports fail
findings.confidence: Confirmed from source and/or focused fixture behavior
findings.resolution: Emit executable resolved tests and register/cache imported modules.

findings.trigger: Fit and split operations occur in different notebook cells
findings.impact_reason: leakage checks miss the combined pipeline
findings.confidence: Confirmed from source and/or focused fixture behavior
findings.resolution: Analyze combined source while retaining original cell locations.

findings.trigger: A notebook uses the documented stdlib output-strip fallback
findings.impact_reason: opening for write first can truncate the notebook
findings.confidence: Confirmed from source and/or focused fixture behavior
findings.resolution: Use a validated atomic replacement helper and preserve content/permissions.

findings.trigger: Stable notebook functions already exist inside larger source modules
findings.impact_reason: duplicate logic is missed; output byte counts can be inaccurate
findings.confidence: Confirmed from source and/or focused fixture behavior
findings.resolution: Compare individual functions and count UTF-8 output bytes.

findings.trigger: Provenance JSON/verification mode is used or a human card lacks a hash
findings.impact_reason: invalid JSON, false-current results, unnecessary profiling, or overwritten notes
findings.confidence: Confirmed from source and/or focused fixture behavior
findings.resolution: Separate output/mutation modes, hash-only verification, preserve cards, and fail on missing records.

findings.trigger: Graph edges have a source endpoint but no provenance reference
findings.impact_reason: an endpoint was mistaken for evidence provenance
findings.confidence: Confirmed from source and/or focused fixture behavior
findings.resolution: Validate explicit provenance references and their resolution.

findings.trigger: Model serving lives under app/ or api/ rather than backend/
findings.impact_reason: real inference paths can be mislabeled demo-only
findings.confidence: Confirmed from source and/or focused fixture behavior
findings.resolution: Discover active alternative layouts and refresh artifact guidance.

findings.trigger: Aliased statistical model fits or covariance options are used
findings.impact_reason: inference inventory misses fitted model details
findings.confidence: Confirmed from source and/or focused fixture behavior
findings.resolution: Resolve call aliases and fit options in the inventory.

findings.trigger: Ledger logging receives a repo-relative data path, invalid metrics, or an incompatible header
findings.impact_reason: missing provenance or malformed append-only records
findings.confidence: Confirmed from source and/or focused fixture behavior
findings.resolution: Validate before writing; resolve target-relative data; refuse schema mismatch.

findings.trigger: A project virtual environment is named or selected differently from a historical default
findings.impact_reason: doctor probes the wrong environment or gives misleading repair advice
findings.confidence: Confirmed from source and/or focused fixture behavior
findings.resolution: Inspect supplied/project environment and disclose unavailable evidence.

findings.trigger: Git changes include Unicode, tabs, newlines, renames, or many files
findings.impact_reason: manifest corruption or many per-file subprocesses
findings.confidence: Confirmed from source and/or focused fixture behavior
findings.resolution: Use NUL-delimited Git output and explicit JSON-quoted names.

findings.trigger: An untracked dataset or model is large
findings.impact_reason: whole-file inspection spikes memory or exhausts it
findings.confidence: Confirmed from source and/or focused fixture behavior
findings.resolution: Read bounded chunks and stop early for binary files.

findings.trigger: Notes refresh runs on native macOS Bash 3.2
findings.impact_reason: unsupported namerefs abort the workflow
findings.confidence: Confirmed from source and/or focused fixture behavior
findings.resolution: Use a compatible deduplication loop.

findings.trigger: A phase document references a wrong folder with an existing basename or a spaced/encoded path
findings.impact_reason: file existence can be falsely confirmed or missed
findings.confidence: Confirmed from source and/or focused fixture behavior
findings.resolution: Resolve exact paths, decode links, and label basename matches as candidates.

findings.trigger: A Next.js package is detected only as generic React
findings.impact_reason: README discovery uses an incomplete product classification
findings.confidence: Confirmed from source and/or focused fixture behavior
findings.resolution: Prioritize framework-specific evidence.

findings.trigger: A fresh generated project imports undeclared utilities or declares unusable lint/test commands
findings.impact_reason: new development projects fail setup or validation
findings.confidence: Confirmed from source and/or focused fixture behavior
findings.resolution: Declare required dependencies/configuration and exercise actual generated build/tests.

findings.trigger: A new web scaffold selects unsupported Vite 5 or legacy Supabase key guidance
findings.impact_reason: starts new work on unsupported or outdated tooling
findings.confidence: Confirmed from source and/or focused fixture behavior
findings.resolution: Use supported compatible Vite 7.3 and publishable keys for new clients.

findings.trigger: Nested routes, pathless guards, index routes, or basenames are present
findings.impact_reason: incorrect URLs or protected pages can be marked public
findings.confidence: Confirmed from source and/or focused fixture behavior
findings.resolution: Parse static declarations with project TypeScript; keep unresolved routes as candidates.

findings.trigger: Pages keep polling after content is ready
findings.frequency_reason: ordinary analytics or live data pages
findings.impact_reason: network-idle waits delay or prevent captures
findings.confidence: Confirmed from source and/or focused fixture behavior
findings.resolution: Wait for DOM and a content selector; disable animations for captures.

findings.trigger: A dynamic route sample points outside the selected origin
findings.impact_reason: capture visits an unintended page
findings.confidence: Confirmed from source and/or focused fixture behavior
findings.resolution: Validate sample paths before launching the browser.

fixture.layout: src/*.tsx plus node_modules/vendorN/{package.json,19 dependency*.json}; package dependencies empty
fixture.timing: median wall time with identical scandir instrumentation; no network

hash_only_verify.note: Old mode hashes then profiles 50000 CSV rows; new verify mode only hashes

git_manifest.note: Single fixture wall-time comparison, not a whole-workflow guarantee

validation.generated_web: Fresh dependency install, lint and build PASS on Vite 7.3.7; React 18/Tailwind 3 preserved
validation.generated_python: Wheel built; two generated pytest cases passed against wheel using existing ML interpreter
validation.typescript_routes: Real target TypeScript parser fixtures PASS: nesting, guards, basename, route objects, index and unresolved basename
validation.generated_supabase: Fresh dependency install, lint and production build PASS; publishable-key client configuration

limits: No live Chromium visual rendering, external site deployment, signed macOS release, or store submission was performed.
Static scanner matches remain candidates until verified in each future target project.
Historical Python ML pins remain an explicit compatibility preset, not a claim of latest versions.
Benchmarks are fixture-specific and exclude external service/network performance.
